_help: Add events and presentations here; the page sorts them by date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Every field except date and title can be left out. kind: conference, meetup, online, workshop or talk. A presentation can name its slide pictures with 'images' (a folder and a count: folder/slide-01.jpg …), so it can be paged through on the page, and its files with 'slides' (PDF) and 'pptx'.

presentations.title: Incentium — Introduction
presentations.summary: What Incentium is, how the price of ICT and the number of miners are linked, how trading and AI mining work, and the road to 2028. Updated 25 Nov 2026 with the subnet auction and Alpha decisions.
